profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack. JavaScript, React, Python, Django. 4+ years of experience.

positions.title: Python Backend Developer
positions.description: Senior Python backend programmer for a phone app. Built on Flask, using SQLAlchemy as ORM, deployed in Heroku. Using Cloudinary as a CDN for profile pics and receipts. The receipts are ran through an OCR, Google Cloud Vision API. Extracting data from files with Pandas and using Postgres for database. Using Heroku Scheduler to clean data and send Firebase notifications.

positions.title: Computer Science Teacher
positions.description: Taught Full Stack Web Development. With an outgoing and friendly personality I connected very well with my students to see their rate of understanding and teach on a more personal level. Subjects covered: JavaScript, React, Webpack, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS, Data Structures, Algorithms, Git, Bash, Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, SQL, File Manipulation, Requests, Heroku, Git, REST, Data Structures.

positions.title: Programming Teacher
positions.description: I greatly enjoy teaching and connecting with the students. Taught Full Stack Development: JavaScript, React, Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, SQL, HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, Webpack. We also played with Raspberry Pis, Arduinos, Drones ran with Python scripts, GPS, all sorts of sensors, bar code gun..

positions.title: Warehouse Manager
positions.description:
Created work schedules, distributed tasks, hired staff, supervised the loading and unloading of trucks from events, truck maintenance, supervised event preparation, organization of the warehouse and workflow. Delivering events in a timely manner is crucial for an effective execution of the event.
Connected personally with staff to be able to work more efficiently with their strengths to better the quality of work for themselves and the company.

company.name: Bill Hansen Catering and Event Production

educations.schoolName: Florida International University - College of Engineering & Computing
